description: Preview an email template without sending anything: never sends and never records an email log. Use it to check wording before send_email; pass a contactId to fill in that person's merge variables. Returns the rendered subject, the merged HTML body (size-capped), and recipientPreview, the address it would go to.

contactId.description: Optional contact id to use as the variable-substitution context.

eventId.description: Event id, as returned by list_events.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

templateId.description: The email template id (org or event template).

name: draft_email

recipientPreview.description: Address it would go to, or '(no contact selected)'.
